title: Global CSS & Applying Styles
description: Add your first global stylesheet in the right place and understand how it flows through your app.

slides.title: Where to Put Global Styles 🌍
The _app.js Wrapper (pages/_app.js)
slides.content: This file wraps every page. It's the best place for global CSS and layout components.

quizData.question: Why must global CSS be imported only in `_app.js`?

options.text: Because other files don't support CSS
To ensure proper style ordering and avoid conflicts between pages
To make the CSS file smaller
It's just a convention, technically any page can import global CSS

quizData.explanation: Next.js enforces this to guarantee that global styles are loaded in a consistent order across all pages, preventing component‑level style leakage.

slides.title: Writing Global Styles ✍️
styles/globals.css
slides.content: A clean reset that improves cross‑browser consistency.

quizData.question: If you import `globals.css` in a page component instead of `_app.js`, what happens?

options.text: Next.js throws an error because global CSS can only be imported in `_app.js`
The styles are scoped to that page only

quizData.explanation: Next.js blocks global CSS imports outside `_app.js` to prevent style ordering issues and unintended side effects.
